_comment: The two days as a calendar, policy and technical tracks side by side, for the workshop hub (tools/workshop/module-pages.ts). The technical sessions and the joint sessions come from technical-track.json (the owner's draft technical schedule, 16 November 2026); this file adds the rows both tracks share (logistics and breaks, from the same schedule) and the policy track's slots. The policy slots are a PROPOSAL: the source schedule gives the joint sessions and the technical times but no policy times, so each policy module is placed in the parallel window it most likely fills, by its canvas sheet's timings, and marked to confirm.
